raw.details:
IIITD Programming League:

IIITD Programming League (IPL) is the competitive programming league organized by the Tech Council, IIIT Delhi. Modelled on a knockout format, the league brings together some of the strongest competitive programmers from across the country to face off in head-to-head 1v1 battles of algorithms, speed, and problem-solving.

Unlike a traditional contest where hundreds of participants solve the same set, IPL pits two programmers against each other in every match. Each round raises the difficulty and the stakes, until a single champion remains.

The event is open to students from all institutions and academic backgrounds, provided they meet the shortlisting criteria.

  • Please do join the official whatsapp group for doubts and queries: WhatsApp group
  • Follow the official Insta handle for updates: Instagram Handle

Event Highlights:

  • National-Level Competitive Programming League
  • Offline Knockout Finale at IIIT Delhi
  • Head-to-Head 1v1 Format
  • No Registration Fee
  • Total Prize Pool of ₹1,00,000+
  • Cash Prize Pool of ₹50,000+
  • Additional In-Kind Rewards and Credits

Competition Format:

IPL will be conducted in two rounds.

Round 1: Shortlisting

Round 1 shortlisting will be based on competitive programming profiles. Approximately 200 participants will be shortlisted for the offline league at IIIT Delhi.

Shortlisting will be based on:

  • Competitive programming profile and ratings (Codeforces, CodeChef, AtCoder, LeetCode, etc.)
  • Contest participation history and consistency
  • Notable achievements
  • Any other relevant proof of problem-solving ability submitted with the application

Round 2: Elimination Rounds

Round 2 will consist of elimination rounds at IIIT Delhi, held as 1v1 matches. Details will be shared with the shortlisted participants.

Match Format:

  • Each match is a 1v1 duel between two programmers on a shared problem set.
  • Tie-breaker rules will be defined by the organizing team.

Shortlisting & Registration Guidelines:

  • Registration is done through Unstop.
  • Participants must submit links to their competitive programming profiles.
  • Only individual participation is allowed.
  • Approximately 200 participants will be shortlisted based on profile evaluation.
  • Shortlisted participants will be notified via email and official channels.

Offline League Experience (Only For Shortlisted Finalists):

Opening Ceremony:

Introduction to the league, rules, match format, bracket reveal, and judging/adjudication process.

Elimination Rounds:

Live 1v1 matches across all rounds, with brackets updated in real time.

Semi-Finals & Grand Final:

The final participants will compete in high-stakes showdowns, culminating in the Grand Final to crown the IPL champion.

Closing Ceremony:

Announcement of winners and distribution of prizes. A detailed schedule will be released closer to the event.

Prize Pool:

  • Total Prize Pool of ₹1,00,000+
  • Cash Prize Pool: ₹60,000+
  • Additional In-Kind Rewards and Credits

Prize distribution details will be announced closer to the event.

Additional Benefits:

Participants may also receive:

  • Product Subscriptions
  • Merchandise and Goodies
  • Community Perks
  • Partner Benefits
  • Exclusive Opportunities from Supporting Organizations

Subject to final partnerships and collaborations.

Eligibility:

  • Open to students across India
  • Participants from any academic background may apply
  • Individual participation only
  • Selection is subject to profile-based shortlisting
  • No registration fee

Rules & Conduct:

  • Profiles should be legit, any profile found to be of someone else, or fake will be flagged.
  • Participants must compete individually, without external assistance.
  • Use of AI tools, unauthorized resources, or communication with others during matches is strictly prohibited.
  • Any form of plagiarism, cheating, or unfair means will lead to immediate disqualification.
  • The decision of the organizing team and judges will be final.
  • Any violation of event guidelines may result in disqualification.

Facilities For Offline Participants:

Infrastructure Support:

  • High-Speed Internet Access
  • Power Access
  • Dedicated Contest Arena with Workstations

Event Support:

  • Volunteer Assistance
  • Help Desk
  • Logistics Support

Why Participate?

  • Test your skills in intense head-to-head battles
  • Compete against the best programmers in the country
  • Showcase your problem-solving ability
  • Network with talented coders from across India
  • Strengthen your competitive programming profile
  • Compete for cash prizes and additional rewards
  • Experience a national-level programming league at IIIT Delhi

Important Note:

All event timelines, match formats, bracket structures, shortlisting criteria, prize distribution details, partnership announcements, and operational guidelines are subject to updates by the organizing team.

Participants are encouraged to regularly check official communication channels for announcements and updates regarding IIITD Programming League.
